assumptions: 400 mm seismic joint is provisional pending displacement check.
Site soil Type II pending geotechnical confirmation.
Trial connection details and matched source member checks are recorded where available. Each unverified design item retains review status.

Form the circular link restraints from certified IS 2062 E250 B0 feedstock with a full-penetration longitudinal seam. IS 1161 Table 1 supplies finished dimensions. Axial design uses 250 MPa yield, 410 MPa tensile and the cold-formed hollow-section buckling curve.

Flange supplementary steel is included in gravity and earthquake weight as 1.45 kN/m² at levels 1–6, 1.19 kN/m² at levels 7–11 and 0.72 kN/m² at roof. Each floor has its own check against the modeled steel takeoff.

Stem supplementary steel is included in gravity and earthquake weight as 1.45 kN/m² at levels 1–6, 1.19 kN/m² at levels 7–11 and 0.72 kN/m² at roof. Each floor has its own check against the modeled steel takeoff.
